notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.content:
This patch fixes the following issues:
- Added a mouse sensitivity nob in the in-game ESC menu.
- Fixed an issue with a book floating in the library at the wrong time.
- Added more accurate Navigation for NPCs. 
- Fixed an issue where the Monster would get stuck in the door when it was slightly open.

Thanks for Frank Zumpano for pointing out these bugs.

notes.title: Patch 1.4 Continued
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the main menu wasn't loading after death.

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
Fixed the following bugs that were pointed out and made clear by valued players:

- Fixed an issue where the door was able to close too quickly on the monster.
- Fixed some voice line audio overlapping after the fire event and Mothers room. 
- Made the map darker for a more horror feel.
- Combined the Library key and the sleeping medicine into one item fixing a few design issues.

Thank you to the following player in particular for posting a video on YouTube that was used for analyzing bugs and gameplay issues:
About50Dollars

You are a valued customer and I thank you for playing the game I made! Hope these fixes help make the game better <3

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content: This patch fixes an issue where the balcony door was not opening with the expected results.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content: This patch was sent out to fix a bug where the Library door would open without a Key.
